features.visitor_job: Browse the shelves and choose an available reference.
features.environment_object: Physical book covers placed in the three shelf bays.
features.desktop: Book objects operate directly in the full room.
features.mobile: The same book objects recompose into labelled shelf reels.
features.accessibility: Buttons expose exact book names and availability; the reader has close/return focus behavior.
features.growth_behavior: Catalogue data populates repeatable shelf bays; more books add shelf inventory rather than requiring a new room image.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new collection receives a named aisle or bay in the Library directory and reuses the operable-book grammar.
features.preview_contract: Selecting or focusing a cover reveals its title, plain-language coverage, contents topics, availability and the result of opening it without opening the reader and without hover dependence.
features.opened_experience: An available book opens as a readable reference-book workspace with continuous scroll, contents navigation, section links and an obvious return to the same shelf position; no decorative page-turn sequence.

features.visitor_job: Ask a plain-language question at the reference desk.
features.environment_object: Miss Jeeves and her reference desk pictured in the room.
features.desktop: The form is integrated into the continuous reference-desk field immediately beneath Miss Jeeves in the masthead.
features.mobile: The same labelled form follows the Miss Jeeves masthead and precedes shelf browsing.
features.accessibility: The visible prompt has an exact form label; submit is keyboard operable and answers use a live results region.
features.growth_behavior: Miss Jeeves indexes additional admitted Library inventory without changing the reference-desk station.
features.new_feature_behavior: New reference capabilities extend the desk only when their real service and state contracts exist.
features.preview_contract: The visible desk label explains that Miss Jeeves accepts a plain-language question and returns a direct answer plus its exact source before the visitor enters the desk view.
features.opened_experience: The desk opens as a focused question-and-answer workspace in the room, with loading, answer, no-answer, source and return states rather than a generic search-results page.

features.visitor_job: Open the useful section rather than losing place in a long reference.
features.environment_object: The opened physical book and its contents.
features.desktop: The book opens in place over the Library.
features.mobile: The opened book uses a single readable column.
features.accessibility: Dialog, labelled title, close and section links are present; independent focus review remains required.
features.growth_behavior: Each admitted book supplies its own generated contents; longer or additional books do not change the room shell.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new reading tool enters the opened-book workspace rather than an unrelated page section.
features.preview_contract: The selected-book preview lists the book's real topics and makes clear that opening enters a scrollable reference with section navigation.
features.opened_experience: The contents remain visible on wide screens and collapse into an accessible jump menu on compact screens; selecting a section scrolls within the continuous book and preserves close/return context.

features.visitor_job: Save an exact useful book or passage and recover it later.
features.environment_object: Puffy Sticker applied to the open book or passage.
features.desktop: Save controls live on the opened book; arrival-room discoverability remains to be judged.
features.mobile: The same save control lives with the opened passage.
features.accessibility: Named buttons and device-local scope exist; complete focus/result/return review remains required.
features.growth_behavior: The Puffy pouch validates and reopens a growing set of canonical book and section locations.
features.new_feature_behavior: New save types require a canonical location and shared ownership contract before appearing on an object.
features.preview_contract: The open-book save control names the exact book or section it will save and its device-local scope before activation.
features.opened_experience: Saving changes the control state in place, confirms the exact saved target and offers a direct but optional path to the Puffy pouch without ejecting the visitor from the book.

features.visitor_job: Continue from a reference into the right lesson, episode, current evidence or bounded help.
features.environment_object: The related route inside the opened reference book.
features.result: Owned destination or explicit held state.
features.desktop: Appears in the opened book/reference-desk result rather than an unrelated card rail.
features.mobile: Same result links follow the answer or passage.
features.accessibility: Link purpose and held state are textual; destination return journey remains to be independently judged.
features.growth_behavior: Related destinations are data-driven and expand without adding a card rail to the room.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new cross-building handoff appears in the relevant opened book or desk answer, with an exact return path.
features.preview_contract: Every related route states its destination type, purpose and availability before activation.
features.opened_experience: The handoff opens the owned destination or an explicit held state and provides a reliable return to the originating answer or passage.

current_blockers: Concepts 101 is the only locally admitted book; all other covers must remain truthful preview-only or coming-later inventory.
A real correction intake, claim-location ledger and propagation path are not implemented.
Native Safari/VoiceOver and public-origin verification remain open.
Account-backed or cross-device Library continuation is unsupported and must not be claimed.
